cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. This café chair wobbles. Let's take all the chairs apart and check their joints.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tested them. It's only this chair, on this floorboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then we'll lift the floorboards. The chairs have exposed a flooring problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll close for renovations. Once the floor's up, we can move the counter and sort out the queue.

mechanism: A uses expert diagnosis and renovation sequencing to turn one wobbling caf? chair into a wider floor and service-layout project despite imminent opening.
confusable: D44 celebrates efficiency savings; D48 specifically uses small problems to justify broader disruptive solutions even when they cost normal operation.
comparison: Home alternative expands through physical dependencies; caf? alternative overrides trading time to broaden the intervention.
seedUse: Chair, floorboard and twenty-minute opening derive from D48-b; S03 supplies fault-location and repair-versus-operating-priority corrections.
